# Jack Wallner

> Independent iOS developer in Vancouver, Washington. Simple iPhone and Apple Watch apps, each with its own page, privacy policy and support.

## Health & body

- [Total Calories - Daily Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vitals/): Private calorie and step tracking from HealthKit, with TDEE burn on Watch and widgets. (App Store)
  - [Active vs Resting Calories on Apple Watch: Total Burn Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vitals/apple-watch-active-vs-resting-calories.html): What active and resting energy mean on Apple Watch, why the Move ring shows only part of your burn, and how to see your total calories burned for the day.
  - [BMR Calculator: Basal Metabolic Rate Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vitals/bmr-calculator.html): Free BMR calculator (Mifflin-St Jeor), what basal metabolic rate means, what changes it, and how Apple Watch resting energy compares.
  - [Calorie burn guides: TDEE, BMR and Apple Watch energy](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vitals/guides.html): Short guides on calories burned: TDEE, BMR, and how Apple Watch measures active and resting energy.
  - [TDEE Calculator: Total Daily Energy Expenditure Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vitals/tdee-calculator.html): Free TDEE calculator using Mifflin-St Jeor, what total daily energy expenditure means, and how to measure your real daily burn with an Apple Watch.
- [Desk Reset: Posture Practice](https://jackwallner.com/ios/posture/): A three-minute guided posture practice with live AirPods cues and optional all-day monitoring. (App Store)
- [Migraine Headache Tracker Log](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/): One-tap headache logging that pairs each entry with health and barometric weather context. (App Store)
  - [Barometric Pressure and Headaches: How to Track the Connection | One Tap Headache Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/barometric-pressure-headaches.html): Learn how barometric pressure changes trigger headaches and migraines, and how to automatically track the connection with your iPhone. Free app captures pressure data with every headache log.
  - [Best Headache Tracker Apps for iPhone in 2026 | One Tap Headache Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/best-headache-tracker-app.html): Compare the best headache and migraine tracking apps for iPhone in 2026. Detailed comparison of One Tap Headache Tracker, Migraine Buddy, Bearable, and N1 Headache: features, privacy, price, and data export.
  - [How to Identify Your Migraine Triggers with Data | One Tap Headache Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/headaches/migraine-trigger-tracking.html): Learn how to track and identify migraine triggers using automatic data capture. Capture weather, sleep, heart rate, air quality, and 60+ data points per headache with zero effort.
- [Fitness Habit Tracker: Auto](https://jackwallner.com/ios/fitness-streaks/): Automatic fitness streak discovery from Apple Health. (App Store)
- [Simple GLP: GLP-1 Dose Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/): One-tap GLP-1 dose logging for weekly shots and daily pills, with schedules and optional Health context. (App Store)
- [VO2 Max & Cardio Fitness](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vo2max/): A focused view of Apple Health cardio fitness estimates, fitness age, trends, and targets. (App Store)
  - [VO2 Max Chart by Age and Sex: Apple Watch Levels](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vo2max/vo2-max-chart-by-age-and-sex.html): VO2 max percentiles by age and sex from the FRIEND registry, how Apple Watch cardio fitness levels use them, and how to read your own number. Sourced and plain.
- [Trip Comfort: Motion Sickness](https://jackwallner.com/ios/queasy/): Four drug-free comfort routines for journeys, with breathing guidance and paced wrist pulses. (App Store)
- [Protein Tracker - Grams Today](https://jackwallner.com/ios/protein/): One number on your wrist: the grams of protein you have tracked today. No calorie counting, no AI food scanning. (Pre-release)
- [Caffeine Tracker: Bedtime](https://jackwallner.com/ios/caffeine/): Preview what another coffee may leave at bedtime before you log it, on iPhone and Apple Watch. (Pre-release)
- [Daylight: Minutes Outside](https://jackwallner.com/ios/daylight/): Daylight time from Apple Health against a computed sunset, so you know the latest you can head out and still hit your target. (Pre-release)

## Habits & recovery

- [Sober: Sobriety Day Counter](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/): Day counter with a virtual garden that grows as sober days add up. (App Store)
  - [Sobriety Milestones: What 30, 60, 90 Days and 1 Year Mean](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/sobriety-milestones.html): What sobriety milestones mean at 30, 60, 90 days and 1 year: chip traditions, what research shows after a month off alcohol, and how to mark each one.
- [Quit Zyn: Pouch & Snus Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/quitzyn/): Nicotine-free day counter, check-ins, and a garden that grows with every day off pouches. (App Store)
- [Shoes On: Time Blindness Coach](https://jackwallner.com/ios/time/): A leave-on-time routine coach with learned step timing, one-day schedule changes, and a next-start widget. (App Store)

## Card & tile games

- [Bridge Trainer: Learn & Bid](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bridge/): Five-minute contract bridge practice for card basics, bidding, declarer play, and defense. (App Store)
- [Cribbage Trainer: Count & Peg](https://jackwallner.com/ios/cribbage/): Five-minute cribbage drills for counting, discarding, pegging, and table judgment. (App Store)
- [Sheepshead Trainer: Trump Play](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sheepshead/): Five-minute sheepshead drills for trump, picking, partner play, and bury decisions. (App Store)
- [Skat Trainer: Learn Skat](https://jackwallner.com/ios/skat/): Short Skat practice for cards, bidding, discarding, and trick decisions. (App Store)
- [Mahj Trainer: Mahjong Practice](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/): Short practice rooms for American Mah Jongg tiles, card reading, Charleston, and table judgment. (App Store)
  - [How to Read the Mah Jongg Card: the 9 Sections Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/card-sections.html): The NMJL card is built from nine sections that keep the same shape every year: 2468, 13579, Consecutive Run, Like Numbers, Winds and Dragons, 369, Quints, Singles and Pairs and the Year hand. Learn to spot each one on a rack.
  - [The Charleston in American Mah Jongg: Rules, Order and Strategy](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/charleston.html): How the Charleston works in American Mah Jongg: the three passes, the optional second Charleston, blind passes, the courtesy pass, and a simple strategy for choosing which three tiles to pass.
  - [American Mah Jongg Glossary: Every Term Explained (Soap, Pung, Kong, Charleston)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/glossary.html): A plain-English glossary of American Mah Jongg terms: craks, bams, dots, soap, pung, kong, quint, exposure, Charleston, blind pass, courtesy pass, joker swap, hot tile, wall game and more.
  - [How to Play American Mah Jongg: Rules for Beginners (2026 Guide)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/how-to-play-american-mahjong.html): The rules of American Mah Jongg in plain English: the 152 tiles, the card, the Charleston, calling, jokers, and how a hand is won. Written for brand-new players.
  - [Learn American Mah Jongg: Rules, the Card, the Charleston, Jokers and Scoring](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/): Free guides to American Mah Jongg from the makers of Mahj Trainer: how to play, how to read the card's nine sections, the Charleston, joker rules, scoring and a full glossary.
  - [Joker Rules in American Mah Jongg: Where They Can and Cannot Go](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/jokers.html): Every joker rule in American Mah Jongg: groups of three or more only, never in pairs or singles, never passed in the Charleston, dead when discarded, and how joker redemption (swapping) works.
  - [American Mah Jongg Scoring and Table Rules: Who Pays What](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/scoring-and-table-rules.html): How payment works when someone wins at American Mah Jongg, when a call is too late, what happens after a wrong mah jongg, dead hands, and wall games.

## Sports

- [Baseball Savvy StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/baseball/): Mobile-first Statcast player cards and leaderboards, refreshed nightly by a scraper pipeline. (App Store)
  - [What Is xwOBA? Barrel Rate, Hard-Hit % and Sprint Speed](https://jackwallner.com/ios/baseball/statcast-metrics-explained.html): What xwOBA, barrel rate, hard-hit rate and sprint speed mean, with the exact Statcast definitions and what a good number looks like in a 2025 MLB season.
- [Sports Cheat Sheet: Daily News](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sports/): Plain-English sports catch-up so casual fans can follow along in five minutes a day. (App Store)
- [Football Next: StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/football/): Every NFL player ranked by percentile, with advanced stats in plain visual form. (App Store)
- [Hockey Edge: Puck StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/hockey/): Every NHL skater and goalie ranked by expected goals, with the xG race behind every game. (Pre-release)
- [Basketball: Hardwood StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/basketball/): Every NBA player ranked on advanced percentiles: usage, true shooting, shot zones, playmaking and on-court impact. (Pre-release)
- [IM Tri Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/ironman/): Published full and half-distance triathlon results ranked by split, with race notes and an optional Race Book export. (App Store)

## Family & life admin

- [Little Gestures: Couples Care](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bond/): Love-language reminders, shared milestones, and a daily check-in for couples. (App Store)
- [Elderhub: Family Care Log](https://jackwallner.com/ios/elderhub/): One shared medication and medical record for the parent or partner your family looks after. (App Store)
- [Baby Docs: Newborn Paperwork](https://jackwallner.com/ios/babydocs/): A newborn paperwork concierge: which tasks apply to your household, when each window closes, and where to go. (App Store)
  - [Newborn Paperwork Checklist: Certificate, SSN, Insurance](https://jackwallner.com/ios/babydocs/newborn-paperwork-checklist.html): A US newborn paperwork checklist: birth certificate, Social Security number and card, and health insurance deadlines (30 days job-based, 60 days Marketplace).
- [Baby Tracker: Feeds & Diapers](https://jackwallner.com/ios/baby/): One tap to log a feed, a diaper, or sleep from iPhone, Apple Watch, or the lock screen, with the first-week diaper count up front. (App Store)
- [Next Cue: ADHD Routine Planner](https://jackwallner.com/ios/adhd/): Daily routines shown one step at a time, with a saved place to pick up again after an interruption. (Pre-release)
